title: Study of adsorption efficiencies of biopolymer-based composites of chitosan with a sulfonic acid functionalized imidazolium ionic liquid for elimination of organic dyes in wastewater
content:

Bio-polymer based composites of chitosan and a N-SO3H functionalized imidazolium ionic liquid were developed as sustainable adsorbent materials for adsorption of dyes from aqueous solution.
